expected_structural_delta: One new helper (gh_api_pages) and one small wrapper (github_list_runners) in providers/github.sh. One opt-out flag in gh_api for one-off GETs. No new files, owners, or dependencies.
minimum_design: One shared pager for GitHub list endpoints (page count from total_count, fail on any failed page). The liveness inventory and the poison-scan job list use it. Deregistration looks up its own registration with GitHub's exact name filter and takes earlier starts from the paged inventory.
outcome: The farm deletes dead GitHub runner registrations for every host, also when the organization lists more than 100 runners and a host's names sort past the first page. Recorded after the code was written (disclosed in the PR).

reuse_decisions.name: gh_api with its ETag cache and rate gate
reuse_decisions.rationale: Every page goes through gh_api, so ETags, rate recording and the background reserve apply unchanged.

reuse_decisions.name: github_reap_stale_registrations
reuse_decisions.rationale: It already deletes offline, idle, unowned registrations; it only needed a complete inventory.

reuse_decisions.name: github_fetch_all
reuse_decisions.rationale: It fans out one request per repository, not pages of one list.
